overall_reason: A plain, dense reference document in the owner's own type family (Geist, Geist Mono): one column of run-in rules with concrete, falsifiable advice ('touch-action: manipulation', '~150-300 ms show-delay'), no hero, no cards, no decoration; it reads as written by people who hold these opinions.
strengths: Every rule is specific and testable: 'Set touch-action: manipulation', 'add a short show-delay (~150-300 ms) & a minimum visible time (~300-500 ms)', 'Set overscroll-behavior: contain intentionally e.g., in modals/drawers'.
The form follows the content: a long list set as a single readable column with bold run-in heads and inline code, no section ornaments to delete.
Named credits ('Thanks to Adam, Jimmy, Jonnie, Lochie, Paco, Joe, & Austin') and a 'Join Vercel' line that is honest about why the page exists.
Fresh-reader check found no hero or heading that would fit any site; the closest generic line is 'Interfaces succeed because of hundreds of choices.', which the list then backs up.
not_investigated: disputed: INT-005 placeholder_residue hits ('Placeholders signal emptiness.', 'Use consistent placeholders.') are guideline text about form placeholders, not leftover placeholder copy.
Page length (2,226 words, sweep CPY-002) is appropriate for a reference document; not treated as slop.
